lines.text: Paul charges Timothy before God and Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, to preach the word.
People will not tolerate sound doctrine, so they will gather teachers to suit their desires and turn aside to idols.
Paul tells Timothy to endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill his ministry.
Paul says he is being poured out like a drink offering, and he has fought the good fight, finished the race, and kept the faith.
The crown of righteousness is laid up for Paul, and only he will receive it from the Lord on that day.
